scope: Frontend-only Mutual defaults and responsive Report layout release

source.note: The released UI changes were uncommitted at deployment. Exact deployed bytes are recorded in the preview/live asset evidence; this is not a claim that baseCommit alone reproduces this release.

warnings: Neon recovery retention remains six hours on the temporarily retained Free plan.
strictProductionHardening.note: The npm wrapper's nested Windows PowerShell invocation lacked Get-FileHash in this host's inherited module environment. The unchanged strict script passed under PowerShell 7, including the budget check. Existing recent recovery and recipient-confirmed alert-delivery evidence were revalidated; no new restore drill or alert was triggered.

rollback.instruction: If rollback is required, first reverify the retained channel still contains the previous version, then clone only that Hosting channel to live. Leave the compatible backend and database unchanged.

limitations: Hosted verification for this frontend-only release was anonymous/read-only; authenticated Department and Report workflows passed locally, not through production accounts in this release.
Physical-phone keyboard, native date picker, upload and installed-PWA checks remain pending.
Single-use Worker invitations, least-privilege Neon runtime access, loaded pool/scale sizing, and longer recovery remain controlled-pilot follow-ups.
